name: docsmith
description: DocSmith — a standalone, data-agnostic document & report template designer: drag-and-drop authoring web component + pull-adapter data contract + Puppeteer PDF render service. ERP is one use case; any data source works.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @docsmith/core build && pnpm --filter @docsmith/adapters build && pnpm --filter @docsmith/sdk build && pnpm --filter @docsmith/render-service build
scripts.demo: pnpm --filter @docsmith/core build && pnpm --filter @docsmith/adapters build && node examples/invoice-demo/demo.mjs
